subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow fresh-session fix for accepted gateway disconnects, or should it pause until the reattach-first design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 is decided?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session transcript collision, but it preserves a recook-first fallback that can still duplicate model/tool side effects and delivered messages on a fresh session.

options.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the same two-run boundary already used by timeout fallback, refresh on current main, and track reattach-first behavior separately.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this PR so accepted disconnects try `agent.wait`/reply recovery before any embedded fallback.

options.title: Pause for product decision
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not land until maintainers decide whether recook-first is acceptable for accepted gateway disconnects.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the same two-run boundary already used by timeout fallback, refresh on current main, and track reattach-first behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent path history on the CLI gateway dispatch and timeout/fallback surface.
